osmNameToLetter.$comment: Maps the OSM building names we fetched onto the published letters. Matches are by USE, stated one by one rather than by a fuzzy rule, so a wrong one is visible in a diff. Buildings not listed here keep a generated placeholder and are flagged in the data — an unmapped building is an admission, not a gap to paper over.

$osmNameToLetterNote: OSM independently carries 'Gebäude G', 'Gebäude H' and 'Gebäude I' — three letters that match the official plan exactly. That agreement between two unrelated sources is the reason to trust the rest of this mapping.
$indoorFinding: ⚠️ THE ONE BUILDING OSM HAS MAPPED INDOORS IS BUILDING K. The 29 `indoor=room` features found in the Seybothstraße probe carry refs K 001 … K 018 ('K 001 Großer Hörsaal', 'K 006 CIP-Pool'), and the published plan says Gebäude K is the Fakultät Informatik und Mathematik at Galgenbergstraße 32 — one of the two faculties this dataset models. So the exploding-building demo can open on REAL room geometry for K and generated plates everywhere else, with the difference badged.
$roomCodeFormat: Both spellings occur in the wild: OSM has 'K 001' with a space, and an OTH event page cites 'Raum D002' without one. Normalise to the compact form and keep the pattern tolerant.
$floorPlans: NO per-floor room plans are published. What OTH publishes is SITE plans: a campus overview PDF for Galgenberg and a 2D site plan PNG for Prüfeninger Straße (both cached under data/oth-plans/). The Prüfening plan is useful for a second reason — it shows Gebäude P as a large L-shaped complex with a Cafeteria and a Teilbibliothek, which confirms the suspicion recorded in the AOI config that the 134 x 230 m OSM outline of that campus is partial.
